tasks.title: Grade checker
Lucky number

hints.compile: Look at line 2. One = puts a value in a box. To ask "is it equal?" you need two: ==
Check the round brackets around the condition, the curly braces, and the semicolons. && is two & signs.
hints.other: Try if (age >= 13 && age <= 19). Check 13 and 19 carefully: they are teenagers too.

hints.compile: Use == to compare. Put the condition in round brackets and each road's code in curly braces.
hints.other: Compare with == "gold" in lowercase. "Gold" with a capital is a different password.
